# Lexonia Pro Clean

> Commercial cleaning for offices and small retail stores in Eden Prairie, Minnesota and the Twin Cities metro. Insured, background-checked crews, a written checklist every visit, evenings and nights.

Lexonia Pro Clean LLC is based in Eden Prairie, MN and serves the Twin Cities metro. If a business is just outside the metro, it can still ask.

## Key facts

- Who we serve: offices and small retail stores and boutiques.
- Where: based in Eden Prairie, serving the Twin Cities metro. A business just outside the metro can still ask.
- What we do: recurring commercial cleaning on a written checklist, with a completed copy left on site after every visit. Restrooms, break rooms, workspaces, common areas, conference rooms, sales floors, mirrors and fitting rooms.
- When: evenings and nights, when the business is closed.
- Pricing: a free walkthrough, then a written scope and an exact price within 24 hours. No surprise fees and no travel charges. Recurring cleaning up to 10,000 sq ft is priced per visit by size of space, weekly or every other week, before sales tax; the current price card is on the Services page. Interior windows are an add-on, priced by the number of windows. Daily cleaning, or a space over 10,000 sq ft: a flat monthly contract quoted after the walkthrough. Multi-story buildings: custom pricing, at greater discounts. For an exact price, request a free quote.
- Process: a free walkthrough of about 45 to 60 minutes, a written scope and exact price within 24 hours, then recurring cleaning. The first visit is a reset clean, recurring visits maintain it, and we check in after two weeks and adjust the scope until it fits.
- Supplies: we bring the cleaning liquids and our own equipment, all included in the price.
- Consumables: the client's company or building management supplies trash bags, soap, paper towels, tissue and restroom disposal bags. We do not supply or buy them. We restock them from the client's supply and say when something is running low.
- Multi-story buildings: we can clean a different floor, or two floors, each night, so the whole building is cleaned once every 1-2 weeks, depending on what it needs. Custom pricing, at greater discounts.
- Interior windows can be added to a visit.
- Not included: operating or maintaining machines, moving furniture, equipment or paperwork, biohazard, hoarding or post-construction cleanup.
- Insured and background-checked crews. Every message gets a same-day response.
